term.label: C-D_H_ACA_box_scaRNA

definition.text: A scaRNA possessing both box C/D and box H/ACA sequence motifs, guiding both the methylation and pseudouridylation of snRNAs.

comments: Added at the request of Steven Marygold. See GitHub Issue #519 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/519).
